title: Choose how Carnet feels
question: You asked for a difference in the look and the feeling, not in features. These are whole renderings of the same screens, with the same features and the same layout. The roll dealt Risographie; my pick is Lumière. Take one, steer it, or re-roll (safer or bolder).

options.label: Risographie
options.lineage: Riso zines and French micro-édition: spot inks laid one pass at a time, halftone screens, overprint
options.thesis: Carnet is printed, not rendered: the ground is a screen of one ink, sheets are knocked out to bare paper, and the cut-outs overprint in two inks a hair off register while text always prints true.
materials: a 1.5px black key line on every control
options.viewport: Board on a blue screen with paper sheets knocked out, blue section heads, a solid blue bar holding the matcha pebble. Mode prints its flower huge in a pink screen. The drawer is a bare paper sheet with overprinted emblems.
options.risk: Ink effects can read loose, so off-register lives on the cut-outs only. The inks leave habits-garden's palette: Bonsai follows or the family drifts apart.
options.case: The most distinctive at a glance: no notes app looks printed.

raised.raise: Only the cut-outs break register; text, rules and sheets always print true.
One rule weight everywhere: 1.5px of black ink on every control's edge, never a grey hairline.
Only the chosen collection prints at full ink; the others recede to a 40% screen.
Every state reads in one ink: dashed pending, solid filed, struck failed; colour only confirms.

options.label: Lumière
options.lineage: A desk by a window: one low sun, soft long shadows, the dappled shade of a plant on the sill, moonlight after dark
options.thesis: Carnet lies in daylight: every sheet lifts under one low sun, a plant's shade drifts slowly across the ground, pebbles catch the light, and the light follows the hour, golden at evening, moonlit at night.
materials: one light source: soft directional shadows
slow dappled leaf shade on the ground, faint on the sheets
options.viewport: Same board, same colours: sheets cast soft shadows to the lower right, leaf shade lies across the top, the capture pebble is a lit stone. At night the light turns cool and moonlit; a collection's page sits in the same light.
options.risk: The most familiar of the two: it keeps the cream world and changes how it feels, not what it is. Too faint it reads as nothing, too strong as wallpaper.
options.case: Pure feeling, no new feature and no new colour: the light is the identity.

options.label: Spectre
options.lineage: a glass spectrogram on a charcoal continuum
options.thesis: Notes as ash plates on charcoal, collections as seven hairline colours on one rail, state in line form.
options.viewport: A dark rail with collections as coloured hairlines.
options.risk: A lab instrument for a personal notebook.
options.case: Cold where Carnet is warm, and collections lose their colour and emblems.
options.kept: Every state reads in one ink: dashed pending, solid filed, struck failed.

options.label: Plein écran
options.lineage: a vertical media feed, one item per screen
options.thesis: Each note or link fills the screen, the next one a flick away.
options.viewport: One note at a time, swiped vertically.
options.risk: Breaks the board you scan by the hundred.
options.case: Replaces your layout, which stays pinned.
options.kept: Opening is instant: what is under your finger is already drawn.

options.label: Plan de métro
options.thesis: Collections as coloured lines meeting at interchanges.
options.viewport: The board as a diagram of lines.
options.case: You chose then dropped its navy signage in round 1.
options.kept: The chosen line burns brightest: only the chosen collection prints at full ink.

options.label: Densité japonaise
options.thesis: Tiny type in ruled modules with red tabs, far more per screen.
options.viewport: A packed mosaic of small boxes.
options.risk: Busy where Carnet must stay calm at a hundred notes.
options.case: Density fights the calm board you asked for.
options.kept: One rule weight everywhere, in ink.

options.label: Grille Crouwel
options.thesis: A visible construction grid, monumental grid-built titles.
options.viewport: The board on a construction grid.
options.risk: A grid ground, which Le cahier already showed you.
options.case: Too close to the grid you just turned down, and it trades Signika for constructed letters.
options.kept: One rebellion per screen: only the cut-outs leave the register.

options.label: Course d'orientation
options.lineage: orienteering maps: ISOM inks, contours, a purple course
options.thesis: Collections as terrain colours, the active one in course purple over contour lines.
options.viewport: The board over a faint topographic ground.
options.risk: A third map world after the métro and the garden map.
options.case: You have passed on map worlds twice.
options.kept: One ink is reserved for what is chosen.

canonCard.label: La norme du genre
canonCard.thesis: Google Keep on Material 3, executed impeccably: outlined cards, a full-round search bar, small chips, a standard FAB.
